description: This source file defines a struct and an enum related to sanitizing and inspecting environment variables and overrides for security purposes in an application, with logic for filtering, normalization, and validation of environment variable keys.

classes.name: HostEnvOverrideDiagnostics
classes.description: A data structure representing diagnostics information about blocked and invalid environment variable overrides.

classes.name: HostEnvSanitizer
classes.description: A static utility enum providing functions to sanitize, validate, and inspect environment variable overrides for security purposes.

methods.name: inspectOverrides
methods.description: Inspects a set of environment variable overrides and returns diagnostics about which keys are blocked or invalid, with optional path override blocking.

methods.name: sanitize
methods.description: Sanitizes environment variables and optional overrides, filtering out blocked keys and applying security rules, returning a cleaned dictionary of environment variables.
